summary: Provisioning (`provisionIssueWorkspace`) writes the pane helper into the shared clone's git config as `credential.helper` and `credential.https://github.com.helper`, plus `credential.interactive=false`. The next provisioning's `jj git fetch -R <clone>` (and the clone) runs with `createProvisioningCredential`'s env (askpass script + token + GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0). git >= 2.44 (worker image: 2.47.3) runs the pane helper first — no grant in the init container, so it fails — and `credential.interactive=false` then forbids the askpass fallback: `fatal: unable to get password from user`. Every second provisioning on Kubernetes fails; resume/respawn is blocked. Fix (controller ruling 2026-09-15 03:55Z): keep the persisted config exactly as it is; add five environment pairs to the provisioning env so jj's git subprocess resets the helper chain and re-enables askpass for those commands only.

fixContract.where: packages/workspace/src/workspace.ts, `createProvisioningCredential` — the one env both `provisionIssueWorkspace` (tmux daemon host: clone via `ensureRepoClone`, fetch) and `legion workspace-init` (pod init container, packages/daemon/src/cli/workspace-init.ts, via `processEnvRunner` which lays this env over the pod's own) hand to `jj git clone` / `jj git fetch`.
fixContract.whyPairsNotFlags: jj, not our code, spawns git for `jj git fetch`; `-c` cannot be passed. Git reads `GIT_CONFIG_*` as command-line scope, i.e. after the repository config, so an empty `credential.helper` clears every helper read before it — the general entry and the URL-specific `credential.https://github.com.helper` alike (git's credential_config_callback clears the helper list on an empty value; urlmatch delivers both keys to it in read order).
fixContract.noOtherChange: No change to the persisted config writes (the five `git config` commands at the end of `provisionIssueWorkspace`), to `ensureRepoClone`, `createWorkspace`, `removeRepoScopedIdentity`, the abandon-unreachable-commits read/write, or `workspace-init.ts`. No `LegionDaemonApi` shape change; no state version bump; no plugin contract bump.
fixContract.scrubCheck: `isSecretLikeName` (environment.ts) matches `_KEY` only at the end of a name (`/(?:…|_KEY|…)(?:_FILE)?$/i`), so `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1` are not credential-shaped and nothing in the daemon strips them; the pane env's `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0` (processes.ts) is a different process and untouched. On the daemon host `createDaemonRunner` merges `{...paneEnv, ...options.env}`, and in the pod `processEnvRunner` merges `{...env, ...opts.env}` — the provisioning env wins in both.

git semantics on the dev box (git 2.43.0), bare repo with a marker-writing failing stub helper for both keys + credential.interactive=false, `git credential fill` protocol=https host=github.com, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1: today's env -> stub RUNS (marker written), then 2.43 ignores interactive=false and askpass answers; with the five pairs -> stub never runs, askpass answers. `git config --show-origin` shows the pairs as `command line:` scope after both file entries.
